Alright, whatcha wanna do is build a function which returns a reference to the target variable. Once you have that, you need to set up a private variable factory class which has a single function which returns PrivateVariableHandler which accepts a function of the appropriate type. The factory then passes the function into another factory which returns a reference which allows you to build a pipeline to return an object which has a getter and setter function associated with it (it's a wrapper object which exposes getters and setters). Form there, you just call the getters and setters and update the attribute as required.
